name: scaffold-hbar-launchblocks
description: Visual, block-based token launchpad on Hedera: compose a launch as JSON steps, run it on testnet, and seed a SaucerSwap pool so the token is tradeable.

steps.label: Create a testnet account and top it up

steps.text: Paste HEDERA_OPERATOR_ID and HEDERA_OPERATOR_KEY into that file. A full launch costs 60–80 HBAR on testnet: the SaucerSwap pool and the token's creation fee are most of it.

sections.title: Check the setup before spending anything

steps.label: Compile the contracts the Deploy contract block uses
Verify the operator, network and balance
Validate a launch without sending anything
Run the gallery flow from the terminal
Or start the app and use the block editor

sections.title: Optional: extend it with Hedera Harness

steps.label: Let an agent add an hts.burn step, graded by the harness

steps.text: See .harness/README.md: the harness forbids .env files in the workspace, so export the operator in your shell. The recipe's commands are fixed to the template's default package manager, so it needs a project scaffolded with it.
